findings.title: Earth as an expanded field of capacity
findings.claim: When the focus's familiar earth meets wider earth-spreading and prepared-ground formulations, the sworn lower surface becomes an expanded field in which life and action can occur.
findings.mechanism: The definite earth carrier and the perfect spreading action contact direct wider descriptions of earth being spread and placed for living beings, so terrestrial ground is read together with the capacity created by its extension.
findings.reader_payoff: The earth becomes perceptible as usable room under the sky, not only as a location named in the oath.
findings.containment: The plain oath object remains the earth and the verb remains its spreading; the field-of-capacity reading is a qualified wider resonance, not a claim that every occurrence of the root carries a hidden purpose.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding and a legacy duplicate agree with direct wider connection rows, while the capacity or purpose relation remains an inference beyond the literal earth-spreading clause.
